decision_rules: FULL_GRAPHICAL_REPEAT_SUPPORT requires positively supported compatibility of the complete construction and all eight significant features, full owned target routes and relevant endpoints/bars/returns/marks; unknown is never compatible by default.

OBSERVED_GRAPHICAL_DIFFERENCE requires at least one concrete positively seen owned difference with FULL relevant visibility on both targets and exact feature/source references. Record STRUCTURAL_FEATURE_DIFFERENCE or VISIBLE_FORM_VARIATION; both have UNKNOWN cipher and allographic significance.

An unrelated uncertain dimension does not erase a visible paired difference. Unresolved ownership/visibility of the asserted difference, blur, prose inequality or unknown interpreted as absence cannot support it.
UNCERTAIN preserves actual observed variations and identifies the missing source binding, visibility or unresolved relation. Do not infer new observations for any unchecked queue pair.
No initial report reads the other reader or historical feature/outcome claims before both initial reports freeze; disclose actual prior exposure truthfully.
Native coordinates and source context membership are locators, not physical route masks or mechanical ownership proofs. Source continuity/ownership remains the reader judgment.

Approximate target-box intersection is never a hard ownership or containment gate. Witnesses must lie inside the correct expanded context and bind the exact target/frame/feature references; owned witnesses outside the approximate box require explicit source continuity grounds. Rectangle overlap alone never proves binding.

A final aggregate requires actual relevant source grounds, not matching outcome votes. Preserve every raw locally observed difference and uncertainty even when aggregate UNCERTAIN; do not silently normalize terminal, return, position or extent variation away for repeat support.
serialization: UTF-8 JSON, immutable initial report. Omit per-panel/body/row pixel hashes and private proof rows. Use exact source references within this report; no historical labels, graph classes, letters or global reading-order assumptions.
